what_changed: CFPB Circular 2024-07 on whether card issuers or rewards partners can violate the law by devaluing or blocking redemption of earned credit card rewards.
rationale: Rewards-program design and administration is not a servicing behavior in the relevance test (contact, disclosures, payments, disputes, recovery); near the line only for card servicing. Stage A: title, abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
